profile_text.body:
The AI Now Institute is a nonprofit founded in 2017 and headquartered in New York, NY. Its website describes the organization as one that challenges and reimagines the current trajectory for AI.

The site features commentary from staff members Aya Ibrahim, Sarah Myers West, and Heidy Khlaaf. Ibrahim discusses policymaker deference to the tech sector, West discusses an unregulated sector engaged in a race to the bottom and the need to break down actual AI risks, and Khlaaf comments on security engineering after the OpenAI hack.

The institute has a New York law exposure count of 458. No products, litigation cases, or MCP servers are listed for it.
